text:
maria: Heads-up — new customer 'OrionEdge' needs p5/g5 capacity in eu-west-3 and ap-east-1 for a canary next week. New AWS account: 987654321098. Can someone own quota requests and ENI checks?

kai: I can take this. Do we have exact counts + timeline?

maria: Timeline: canary Mon 2024-03-25. Start 2x p5 for canary, scale to ~12 p5 + 20 g5 over two weeks. Requesting safety quotas: p5=30, g5=50, p4d=10 per-region; ENI headroom ~400 across AZs in eu-west-3.

lee: Which region do we prioritize?

maria: eu-west-3 first for latency to their EU customers, ap-east-1 after canary if all good.

devops-bot: AWS support case opened: 1234567890. Status: awaiting AWS response. Filed by @kai.

kai: Filed case 1234567890. AWS asked for: 1) expected monthly spend, 2) architecture diagram, 3) usage pattern (steady vs burst). I put the canary + projection and noted bursty scale.

maria: Also call out EFA requirement for p5s and ENI/security-group scaling. AWS sometimes approves instances but forgets ENI/EFA quotas.

lee: Quick quota check I ran: current quotas in eu-west-3 = p5: 0, g5: 0, p4d: 0, ENI: 200. Command I used:```bash
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1234ABCD --region eu-west-3
```Replace quota-code per instance family.

kai: Added ENI justification and an expected monthly spend note to the case: steady ~$150k/mo, peak ~$300k/mo. AWS asked to confirm billing contact.

maria: Rough estimate if they hit requested safety capacity continuously: ~ $200k–$300k/month (we'll refine). No commit yet — just for AWS justification.

devops-bot: Case 1234567890 updated by kai at 1723456950: added ENI & billing contact (billing@orionedge.com).

aws-support: AWS Support: Received case 1234567890. We will review the request and may require account owner verification. Typical ETA 24–48 hours.

maria: Thanks — Kai, please add OrionEdge account alias and billing contact to the case (done). Also mention expected AZ distribution so they can adjust ENI per-AZ. :thumbsup: 

kai: Done — billing contact added, and architecture diagram attached to the case (simple vpc/subnets/az split + EFA note). Will update thread with any asks.

lee: After quota approval, I'll provision a validation cluster and run a quick perf smoke (latency, kv cache warmup, EFA validation). I need subnet sizes and ENI distribution from infra. I'll post a quick plan.

maria: Perfect. If AWS pushes on spend, we offer a pilot commitment for 3 months and then revisit. For now, the priority is limits unlocked so we can run the canary.

devops-bot: Reminder: file network change request for ENI bump if AWS increases quotas; we'll need subnets sized to support target ENI count.

lee: Noted — I'll draft the subnet resize proposal once aws-support confirms the new ENI quota.

maria: Leaving this thread open until AWS moves case to 'Quota Increased' or asks for more info. Thanks all.
